Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140*.dll, vcruntime140*.dll, concrt140.dll, ...)
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

These DLLs are not part of DVE and are not covered by DVE's MIT license. They are Microsoft's
"Distributable Code" from the Visual C++ Redistributable that ships with Visual Studio. The
Windows build copies the files CMake's InstallRequiredSystemLibraries module finds in the
Visual Studio installation that built the package next to the executables, so the package
runs on a Windows 10/11 PC that does not have the Visual C++ Redistributable installed. (The
Universal C Runtime, ucrtbase.dll / api-ms-win-crt-*.dll, is part of Windows 10 and later
and is not shipped.)

They are redistributed under the license terms of the Visual Studio edition that built the
package (Distributable Code section) and the list of redistributable files in that
installation's redist.txt:
  https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files

This notice is not the license text. The terms do not let the files be distributed on their
own, only as part of a program that uses them, and they must not be modified.
